subtitle: Out Cebu · Cathay Pacific
overview: Fly Cathay Pacific from Cebu via Hong Kong to Changsha, then travel by private coach with an English-speaking guide. Highlights are the Grand Canyon glass bridge, Furong Town, Tianmen Mountain with its cable car and Tianmen Cave, the Fox Lady show, and the Avatar scenic area (Zhangjiajie National Forest Park) with Bafeng Lake. You spend the last night in Hong Kong before flying home. Hotels are 4-star or similar.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Cebu, Jan 22–27 2027 to Mar 12–17 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Changsha: The capital of Hunan province, where the tour lands and gets transferred towards Zhangjiajie.
placeDesc.Grand Canyon C Line Glass Bridge: A glass-bottomed bridge over a deep canyon near Zhangjiajie; the visit includes a VR experience.
placeDesc.Furong Town: An ancient town in Hunan built on a cliff beside a large waterfall.
placeDesc.72 Floor Stilts Tower: A tall hotel building in Zhangjiajie shaped like stilts, viewed from outside.
placeDesc.Tianmen Mountain: A mountain near Zhangjiajie reached by cable car, with a glass walkway; the visit includes Tianmen Cave.
placeDesc.Tianmen Cave: A natural arch-shaped opening high on Tianmen Mountain, visited as part of the mountain tour.
placeDesc.Tianmen Fox Lady Show: An evening stage show in Zhangjiajie telling a fox-spirit legend with music and dance.
placeDesc.Avatar Scenic Area (Zhangjiajie National: A national forest park of tall sandstone pillars, reached on this tour up and down by the Bailong Lift.
placeDesc.Bailong Lift: A large outdoor glass elevator that carries visitors up the cliff face at Zhangjiajie.
placeDesc.No.1 Bridge: A natural stone bridge in Zhangjiajie, a viewpoint within the Avatar scenic area.
placeDesc.Avatar Hallelujah Mountain: A floating-style sandstone peak in Zhangjiajie that is linked to the Avatar movie scenery.
placeDesc.Golden Whip Stream: A scenic walking stream valley in Zhangjiajie, including the Water Around Four Gates viewpoint.
placeDesc.Bafeng Lake: A mountain lake in Zhangjiajie; the tour includes a cruise on the lake.
